items.title: 華爾街拿電鋸大砍輝達目標價 這家銀行從465美元砍至186美元
paras: 《Benzinga》報導，過去三年，華爾街不斷調高輝達的股價目標價，但本週，分析師卻拿出了「電鋸」。
輝達(NVDA-US)創辦人暨執行長黃仁勳週四(12日)離任，由Colette Kress出任臨時執行長。分析師如今開始在沒有黃仁勳的情況下，重新調整評價模型。
根據Benzinga Analyst Ratings，至少9家華爾街大型金融機構今天下調輝達目標價。平均目標價從約343美元降至約217美元，一夕之間下修37%。其中有家銀行的下修幅度遠遠超過其他同業。
(資料來源：Benzinga Analyst Ratings)

Evercore將輝達比照2012年的蘋果評價

Evercore ISI分析師Mark Lipacis週四在報告中，將輝達評等從「優於大盤」調降至「與大盤持平」，並將目標價從465美元大砍60%，降至186美元。
他也將輝達從該公司「最佳核心投資構想」名單中剔除。他的論點並非針對晶片需求，而是投資人願意為輝達每一美元獲利支付多少價格。
事實上，Lipacis對輝達獲利的看法甚至比華爾街整體預期更樂觀。他預估輝達2027年每股盈餘將達16.92美元，高於報告所引用的市場共識15.32美元。
新的目標價，是以他預估輝達2028年每股盈餘23.27美元的8倍本益比計算。
Lipacis指出，這項估值倍數是參考蘋果(AAPL-US)。他表示，iPhone推出後，蘋果的本益比在2007年至2012年間，從38倍降至8倍，即使同期獲利仍持續成長。
根據報告，輝達其實已經走上類似道路。本益比已從今年5月的26倍降至12倍，2023年時更曾高達60倍。
Lipacis寫道：「我們預期輝達的本益比將持續收縮。」他將目前階段稱為「半導體景氣循環的後段」。在這個階段，當企業獲利超越前一波高峰、營收成長放緩，以及供應鏈各環節開始累積庫存時，晶片股的估值通常會下滑。

缺少明確的第二號接班人

領導層危機進一步強化了這項看法。
Lipacis指出，輝達沒有明確的接班計畫，也沒有「一位具備能見度的第二號營運或策略領導人」。他認為，如果尋找新任執行長的過程拖得太久，可能讓公司陷入「領導層真空」。

AI支出熱潮正在降溫

Lipacis也從輝達最大客戶的支出動向中，發現景氣循環可能進入後段的訊號。
根據Evercore資料，四大雲端服務業者在本次財報季僅將2026年資本支出預測調高1%，是至少12季以來最小的增幅。
至於2027年，市場目前預估這些業者的資本支出將達到1兆美元。然而，預估金額的上修幅度已放緩至6%，遠低於7月的24%及4月的38%。
Lipacis提出的不同情境，也顯示輝達股價未來可能面臨極大的波動空間。在悲觀情境下，若以2028年預估獲利的7倍本益比計算，輝達股價將降至89美元。在樂觀情境下，股價則可達387美元，但前提是投資人願意給予21倍本益比，而且資料中心建置速度進一步加快。

分析師目標價仍高於目前股價

輝達股價週四午盤一度重挫14.3%，隨後跌幅收斂至約4%，報約166美元。
即使是Evercore下修後的186美元目標價，仍比當時股價高出約12%。9家機構的平均目標價則高出約31%。
目標價最低的Craig-Hallum與Melius Research，分別給予180美元及185美元，兩家機構均將輝達評級調降至「持有」，但目標價仍高於當時股價。
另一方面，VanEck半導體ETF(SMH-US)本週上漲4.4%，輝達股價卻下跌15.6%。
輝達將於11月17日美股收盤後公布第三季財報。這將是黃仁勳30多年來首次不再親自出面說明財報。

items.title: 黃仁勳離開誰接班？《輝達之道》作者點名「安謀執行長」與「CUDA之父」兩大人選
items.title_en: Who Will Succeed Jensen Huang? Author of "The Nvidia Way" Names Two Top Candidates – ARM CEO and the "Father of CUDA"
paras: 黃仁勳周四(12日)辭去輝達(NVDA-US)的總裁、執行長及董事職務一職，由財務長Colette Kress暫代執行長一職，誰來接班延續過去驚人的成長動能成了當務之急。曾長期研究輝達內部管理方式的《輝達之道》作者金泰(Tae Kim)認為，最適任的兩位人選將是安謀(ARM-US)執行長哈斯(HassRene Haas)，以及在輝達負責資料中心客戶業務的巴克(Ian Buck)。
金泰是矽谷資深科技記者，為《巴隆周刊》(Barron’s)資深撰稿人，曾任《彭博》專欄作家和CNBC Digital投資記者，著有《輝達之道：黃仁勳打造晶片帝國，引領AI浪潮的秘密》(The Nvidia Way: Jensen Huang and the Making of a Tech Giant)一書。
金泰認為，即使黃仁勳因與兩名女性發生婚外情而離職震撼各界，輝達仍擁有足夠的領導人才與制度實力，能在新任執行長接掌下持續蓬勃發展。
目前輝達董事會已列出一份接班人名單並準備審查，而金泰建議董事會應把焦點集中在哈斯和巴克這兩名候選人身上。

哈斯：具豐富經營經驗的企業領導人

金泰的首選是目前擔任安謀執行長、曾任輝達高階主管的哈斯。
哈斯兼具技術理解能力、企業管理經驗與領導才能。在安謀任職期間，他已證明自己有能力成功管理輝達以外的大型科技公司。他也熟悉輝達的企業文化，並已與公司許多高階主管建立一定程度的熟悉度。
這種熟悉程度，在領導層交接期間可能具有重要價值。金泰表示，曾任職輝達的員工對哈斯評價甚高，也很樂於在他手下工作。
由哈斯接任，可望在維持經營延續性的同時，不必只是試圖複製黃仁勳的領導風格。哈斯具備足夠的經驗與對外溝通能力，能讓投資人、員工、客戶及商業夥伴相信，輝達仍由有能力的領導團隊掌舵。

巴克：掌握輝達技術核心的創新領袖

金泰提出的第二位人選，是輝達超大規模運算與高效能運算部門副總裁巴克。
巴克是輝達核心運算架構CUDA(Compute Unified Device Architecture)的重要開創者與發明人，這套軟體平台協助輝達將GPU轉變為現代加速運算與AI開發的核心基礎，業界常稱巴克為「CUDA 之父」
巴克目前負責監督大型雲端服務供應商及其他大型客戶所使用的產品與技術。金泰認為，他具備工程專業、客戶關係，以及在員工之間的威望，足以帶領輝達邁入下一階段的成長。
由巴克接任將對外界釋出強烈訊號：輝達的未來仍將牢牢建立在技術創新之上。

Jonah Alben是不能失去的關鍵高階主管

除了挑選新任執行長，金泰也指出另一項重要任務：留住輝達GPU工程資深副總裁Jonah Alben。
Alben在公司GPU架構開發及長期產品藍圖規劃中扮演關鍵角色。金泰認為，若能留住Alben，並讓他與巴克繼續合作，將有助於確保輝達技術發展不受干擾。
換句話說，董事會面臨的挑戰不只是尋找黃仁勳的接班人，也必須保護負責維持輝達競爭優勢的工程領導團隊。

輝達的未來不只繫於黃仁勳一人

金泰認為，黃仁勳離開代表一個非凡領導時代的結束，但輝達的成功已不再取決於一個人，在適當的領導團隊帶領下，輝達仍能持續引領AI革命。
AI運算需求依然龐大，而公司的技術、人才及客戶關係，為持續成長立下穩固基礎。即使政治壓力、監管措施或國際市場變化拖慢成長速度，金泰仍認為，AI產業背後的市場機會依然相當可觀。

預測市場看好Ian Buck接班機率領先

預測市場已開始為這場接班競賽定價。根據The Action Network追蹤及分析的數據，該平台彙整Kalshi與Polymarket等預測市場的市場定價、交易活動及歷史預測準確度，巴克目前已成為領先者：
巴克(Ian Buck)，輝達高階主管)：隱含機率35.5%
Colette Kress，輝達代理執行長：隱含機率25.5%
哈斯(Rene Haas)，安謀執行長：隱含機率9.1%
蘇姿丰，超微(AMD-us)執行長：隱含機率2.4%
值得注意的是，市場數據顯示，輝達代理執行長Colette Kress的接班機率，明顯高於金泰看好的另一名人選Rene Haas。
The Action Network預測市場分析師Ben Mendelowitz說：「巴克以35.5%的隱含機率在我們的分析中領先，代理執行長Colette Kress則以25.5%緊追在後，輝達的接班人選仍遠未底定。」他指出，這些數據反映著技術專業與領導延續性之間的拉鋸。
不過，市場情緒可能迅速轉變。Mendelowitz指出，在黃仁勳辭職前所追蹤到的市場變化顯示，他離職的機率在短短三天內(11月9日至12日)便從13.2%飆升至76.6%，顯示隨著新消息陸續出現，接班人選的機率也可能同樣劇烈波動。
paras_en: Jensen Huang on Thursday (the 12th) resigned from his roles as President, CEO and director of Nvidia (NVDA-US). CFO Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO, making the search for a successor to sustain the company’s remarkable growth momentum an urgent priority. Tae Kim, author of "The Nvidia Way" and longtime observer of Nvidia’s internal management, believes the two most suitable candidates are ARM (ARM-US) CEO Rene Haas and Ian Buck, who leads Nvidia’s data‑center customer business.

Tae Kim is a veteran Silicon Valley technology reporter, a senior contributor to Barron’s, former Bloomberg columnist and CNBC Digital investment reporter, and author of "The Nvidia Way: Jensen Huang and the Making of a Tech Giant."

Kim argues that even though Huang’s departure—amid revelations of affairs with two women—has shocked the industry, Nvidia still possesses sufficient leadership talent and institutional strength to continue thriving under a new CEO.
Nvidia’s board has already compiled a list of potential successors and is preparing to review it, and Kim advises the board to focus its attention on the two candidates, Haas and Buck.

Haas: A Business Leader with Rich Operational Experience
Kim’s top choice is the current ARM CEO, Rene Haas, who previously held senior positions at Nvidia.

Haas combines technical understanding, corporate management experience and leadership ability. During his tenure at ARM he has demonstrated the capacity to run a large technology firm outside of Nvidia. He is also familiar with Nvidia’s culture and has built a degree of rapport with many of its senior executives.
That familiarity could prove valuable during a leadership transition. Kim notes that former Nvidia employees hold Haas in high regard and are eager to work under his leadership.

If Haas takes the helm, Nvidia could maintain operational continuity without merely trying to replicate Huang’s style. Haas’s experience and external communication skills should reassure investors, employees, customers and partners that the company remains in capable hands.

Buck: An Innovative Leader Who Controls Nvidia’s Technical Core
The second candidate Kim puts forward is Ian Buck, vice‑president of Nvidia’s hyperscale and high‑performance computing division.

Buck is a key creator and inventor of Nvidia’s core computing architecture CUDA (Compute Unified Device Architecture). This software platform helped transform GPUs into the foundation for modern accelerated computing and AI development, earning him the industry nickname “Father of CUDA.”

Buck currently oversees products and technologies used by large cloud service providers and other major customers. Kim believes his engineering expertise, customer relationships, and standing among staff position him to guide Nvidia into its next growth phase.
Buck’s appointment would send a strong signal that Nvidia’s future will remain firmly rooted in technological innovation.

Jonah Alben Is a Critical Senior Executive Who Must Be Retained
Beyond selecting a new CEO, Kim highlights another priority: retaining Jonah Alben, Nvidia’s senior vice‑president of GPU engineering.

Alben plays a pivotal role in Nvidia’s GPU architecture development and long‑term product roadmap. Kim contends that keeping Alben and allowing him to continue working with Buck will help ensure Nvidia’s technical progress stays on track.
In other words, the board’s challenge is not only to find Huang’s successor but also to protect the engineering leadership team that safeguards Nvidia’s competitive edge.

Nvidia’s Future Is Not Tied to Huang Alone
Kim believes Huang’s exit marks the end of an extraordinary leadership era, but Nvidia’s success no longer hinges on a single individual; with the right leadership team, the company can keep driving the AI revolution.

AI compute demand remains massive, and the company’s technology, talent and customer relationships provide a solid foundation for continued growth. Even if political pressure, regulatory actions or shifts in international markets slow the pace, Kim maintains that the market opportunity behind the AI industry remains substantial.

Prediction Markets Favor Ian Buck as the Leading Successor
Prediction markets have begun pricing this succession race. According to data tracked and analyzed by The Action Network, which aggregates pricing, trading activity and historical accuracy from platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket, Buck is currently the front‑runner:
Ian Buck (Nvidia senior executive): implied probability 35.5%
Colette Kress (Nvidia interim CEO): implied probability 25.5%
Rene Haas (ARM CEO): implied probability 9.1%
Lisa Su (AMD‑US CEO): implied probability 2.4%
Notably, market data shows that the implied probability for interim CEO Colette Kress is significantly higher than that for Kim’s other favored candidate, Rene Haas.

The Action Network prediction‑market analyst Ben Mendelowitz said, "Buck leads our analysis with an implied probability of 35.5%, followed by interim CEO Colette Kress at 25.5%; the successor to Nvidia’s helm is still far from decided." He added that the data reflect a tug‑of‑war between technical expertise and leadership continuity.

However, market sentiment can shift rapidly. Mendelowitz pointed out that in the three days before Huang’s resignation (Nov 9‑12) the market‑estimated probability of his departure jumped from 13.2% to 76.6%, indicating that as new information emerges, the odds for each successor could also swing dramatically.

items.title: 從AI晶片到火箭：馬斯克會延攬黃仁勳嗎？預測市場押注仍低
items.title_en: From AI Chips to Rockets: Will Musk Recruit Jensen Huang? Market Bets Remain Low
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)共同創辦人黃仁勳辭去執行長職務後，市場開始猜測他下一步動向。特斯拉(TSLA-US)、SpaceX(SPCX-US)與xAI創辦人伊隆・馬斯克先前表示，若能延攬黃仁勳將是「一種榮幸」，但目前沒有公開證據顯示雙方已談妥職位或合作。
這段話出現在黃仁勳離任前。美東時間周三晚間，財經帳號ZeroHedge在X發文呼籲「伊隆，請聘用黃仁勳」；約兩小時後，馬斯克回覆：「那將是一種榮幸。」隔天早上，黃仁勳辭去輝達總裁、執行長及董事職務，結束長達33年的領導。
預測市場交易者對黃仁勳加入馬斯克旗下公司的押注仍低。Polymarket顯示，黃仁勳在12月31日前加入SpaceX的機率約9%；Kalshi則給他加入SpaceX或xAI約12%的機率，加入特斯拉約9%，加入超微(AMD-US)或台積電(TSM-US)則各約5%。
Kalshi的合約規則較廣，只要黃仁勳在年底前接受正式顧問或董事職務，也可能算作加入相關公司。不同平台的市場條款和結算方式不一，這些機率反映交易者押注，並非正式聘任消息。
黃仁勳與馬斯克過去數月曾公開互相稱讚。黃仁勳10月在BG2 Podcast談及合作時表示「我喜歡和伊隆共事」；馬斯克則曾在X寫道：「老朋友才是最好的朋友。黃仁勳很棒。」
兩人的合作也不限於公開互動。輝達與SpaceX正合作推進Starmind計畫，探索把AI運算基礎設施部署至太空；黃仁勳曾表示，雙方工程團隊正在設計可在太空與地面運作的新型伺服器架構。
除了猜測黃仁勳的去向，交易者也在押注誰會接掌輝達。Polymarket給輝達資深工程主管伊恩・巴克(Ian Buck)約32%的正式CEO接任機率；臨時執行長、財務長柯蕾特・克雷斯(Colette Kress)約23%，但依該市場規則，臨時任命不計入正式接班。
截至報導時，黃仁勳尚未公開說明離開輝達後的規畫，馬斯克也沒有宣布正式聘用邀約。現階段，加入馬斯克旗下公司的說法仍屬市場猜測。
paras_en: After Jensen Huang, co‑founder of Nvidia (NVDA‑US), stepped down as CEO, the market began speculating about his next move. Tesla (TSLA‑US), SpaceX (SPCX‑US) and xAI founder Elon Musk have previously said that recruiting Huang would be "an honor," but there is currently no public evidence that either side has agreed on a position or partnership.

The comment was made before Huang’s resignation. On Wednesday evening Eastern Time, the financial account ZeroHedge posted on X urging "Elon, please hire Jensen Huang"; about two hours later Musk replied, "That would be an honor." The next morning Huang resigned as Nvidia president, CEO and director, ending a 33‑year tenure.

Prediction markets show traders’ bets on Huang joining a Musk‑run company remain low. Polymarket indicates a roughly 9% chance he will join SpaceX by Dec. 31; Kalshi assigns about a 12% chance of him joining SpaceX or xAI, a 9% chance of joining Tesla, and about a 5% chance each for joining AMD (AMD‑US) or TSMC (TSM‑US).

Kalshi’s contract rules are broader: any formal advisory or board role accepted by Huang before year‑end could count as joining the relevant firm. Because market terms and settlement methods differ across platforms, these probabilities reflect traders’ bets, not an official hiring announcement.

Huang and Musk have publicly praised each other over the past few months. In October, Huang said on the BG2 Podcast, "I enjoy working with Elon" when discussing collaboration; Musk later wrote on X, "Old friends are the best friends. Jensen Huang is great."

Their cooperation goes beyond public interaction. Nvidia and SpaceX are collaborating on the Starmind project, exploring the deployment of AI compute infrastructure in space; Huang has said the two engineering teams are designing a new server architecture that can operate both in orbit and on the ground.

Besides speculating on Huang’s destination, traders are also betting on who will take the helm at Nvidia. Polymarket gives senior engineering executive Ian Buck about a 32% chance of becoming the official CEO, while interim CEO and CFO Colette Kress has roughly a 23% chance, though interim appointments are excluded from formal succession under that market’s rules.

At the time of reporting, Huang has not publicly outlined his plans after leaving Nvidia, and Musk has not announced any formal hiring offer. For now, the notion of Huang joining a Musk‑run company remains market speculation.

items.title: 黃仁勳風暴燒向川習會？分析師：中國明年恐連海外AI算力都難租
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Storm Threatens Trump‑Xi Meeting? Analysts Warn China May Struggle to Rent Overseas AI Compute Next Year
paras: 美國總統川普下周將赴中國深圳出席亞太經濟合作會議(APEC)峰會，並與中國國家主席習近平會面。輝達(NVDA-US)創辦人黃仁勳卸任引發的風波，讓晶片出口政策再度受到關注。受訪分析師認為，事件未必立即打亂會談，但明年美方管制可能進一步延伸至中國企業透過海外雲端取得先進AI算力的管道。
據《半島電視台》報導，地緣政治分析師Steve Okun預期，美國國會與行政部門的壓力可能在2027年升高，包括限制遠端使用先進晶片，以及加強對東南亞的晶片出口許可要求。不過，這些仍是可能的政策走向，尚非已公布實施的措施。

川習會未必立即轉向 國會施壓持續升溫

黃仁勳長期主張放寬對中晶片銷售，認為擴大美國技術的使用，有助維持美國在AI領域的領先地位。川普2025年12月批准H200晶片對中銷售，並要求將25%的銷售收入支付美國政府，儘管兩黨對中鷹派均有反對聲音。
黃仁勳今年5月也曾隨川普訪問北京，希望推動因中國進口審批緩慢而受阻的H200銷售，但未宣布突破性進展。
如今他因私人關係與情報疑慮捲入風波，並於周四(12日)卸任。顧問公司Teneo董事總經理Gabriel Wildau表示，川普尚未顯示有意破壞目前美中關係緩和的進程，但可能面臨國會與政府內部鷹派的新壓力。
Omdia首席分析師Lian Jye Su則指出，對AI與中國採取強硬立場，是美國少數跨黨派共識之一。民主黨參議員已要求政府保留輝達對中出口相關文件，凸顯政策監督壓力持續增加。

海外雲端也可能受限 明年留意算力取得管道

Okun認為，明年值得注意的是國會可能通過《遠端存取安全法》，目標在於阻止中國企業透過雲端使用先進晶片。若相關限制落實，即使晶片未運入中國，中國企業取得海外AI運算資源的方式也可能受到影響。
他另指出，美國商務部可能對Megaspeed實施出口管制，或要求運往新加坡、馬來西亞等國的先進晶片取得許可。這些措施可能使2027年美中關係承壓，但他認為，不會在下周就發生。
香港科技大學中國經濟專家Carsten Holz指出，利用新加坡資料中心的輝達晶片服務中國客戶，並非新鮮事。這也使討論焦點延伸至晶片設置地點之外，包括哪些企業能實際使用相關算力。
北京已否認間諜指控。中國外交部發言人毛寧周四批評，美方不應以相關敘事作為科技封鎖的藉口，但也表示，中方願與美方共同落實兩國領導人達成的共識。眼前外交接觸仍在推進，後續晶片與雲端管制是否收緊，則是另一項待觀察的變數。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump will travel to Shenzhen, China next week for the APEC summit and meet Chinese President Xi Jinping. The controversy sparked by Nvidia (NVDA-US) founder Jensen Huang's resignation has refocused attention on chip export policy. Analysts say the episode may not immediately derail the talks, but U.S. controls could expand next year to restrict Chinese firms from accessing advanced AI compute via overseas cloud services.

According to Al‑Jazeera, geopolitical analyst Steve Okun expects pressure from Congress and the executive branch to increase by 2027, potentially limiting remote use of advanced chips and tightening export‑license requirements for Southeast Asia. However, these are possible policy directions, not yet announced measures.

The Trump‑Xi summit may not shift immediately as congressional pressure continues to rise. Huang has long advocated loosening chip sales to China, arguing that broader U.S. technology use helps maintain America’s AI lead. In December 2025, Trump approved sales of H200 chips to China and required 25% of sales revenue to be paid to the U.S. government, despite bipartisan hawkish opposition.
In May this year, Huang accompanied Trump on a visit to Beijing, hoping to push H200 sales that had stalled due to slow Chinese import approvals, but no breakthrough was announced.

Now embroiled in a scandal over personal ties and intelligence concerns, Huang stepped down on Thursday (the 12th). Gabriel Wildau, managing director at consulting firm Teneo, said Trump has not shown intent to derail the current easing of U.S.–China relations, though he may face new hawkish pressure from Congress and within the administration.

Omdia chief analyst Lian Jye Su noted that taking a hard line on AI and China is one of the few bipartisan consensus points in the U.S. Democratic senators have asked the government to retain Nvidia’s export‑related documents to China, highlighting growing policy oversight pressure.

Okun warned that next year Congress may pass a Remote Access Security Act aimed at preventing Chinese firms from using advanced chips via cloud services. If such restrictions take effect, Chinese companies could be impacted even without physical chips entering China, as their ability to obtain overseas AI compute would be hampered.

He also said the U.S. Commerce Department could impose export controls on Megaspeed or require licenses for advanced chips shipped to Singapore, Malaysia and other countries. These steps could strain U.S.–China ties by 2027, though he does not expect them to materialize next week.

Hong Kong University of Science and Technology China‑economics expert Carsten Holz pointed out that using Nvidia chip services hosted in Singapore data centers for Chinese customers is not new. This shifts the discussion beyond chip location to which firms can actually access the compute.

Beijing has denied the espionage allegations. Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning criticized on Thursday that the U.S. should not use such narratives as an excuse for tech blockades, while also stating China is willing to work with the U.S. to implement the consensus reached by the two leaders. Diplomatic contacts are ongoing, and whether future chip and cloud controls tighten remains an open variable to watch.

NVIDIA’s risk extends beyond its share price: how a $400 billion commitment could influence the AI funding chain. Following the resignation of CEO Jensen Huang, investors are concerned not only about succession and stock performance but also about the vast financing network that supports the AI industry. CNBC analysis estimates that NVIDIA’s cloud procurement, project guarantees, and related arrangements amount to roughly $400 billion. A downturn in the sector could ripple through banks and credit markets.

Jensen Huang’s resignation shocks the market as NVIDIA’s market value falls below $4 trillion, wiping out $2 trillion in just a few weeks. On Thursday (12th), NVIDIA’s shares plunged 14% at the open, hitting a low not seen since June 2025, and its market cap fell below $4 trillion for the first time since 2025. Bloomberg reports that the company’s market value dropped as much as $601 billion during the day, and if the decline continued to close, it would set a record for the largest single‑day market‑cap loss for a global stock. Since the high in early October, the share price has fallen about 35%, shrinking the market cap by roughly $2 trillion in just a few weeks.

The U.S. Department of Justice is reportedly investigating two separate cases: a potential smuggling allegation against Super Micro Computer (SMCI) and an antitrust probe into NVIDIA. The SMCI investigation focuses on whether a party linked to Alice Huang attempted to smuggle SMCI products into China, while NVIDIA’s investigation scope remains undisclosed. On Thursday (12th), SMCI shares fell 11.30% to $26.99 per share, and NVIDIA shares dropped 4.34% to $166.19, with a single‑day market‑cap loss exceeding $180 billion.

After a disappointing earnings report, Intel (INTC) saw its shares tumble 29% in a single day, prompting CEO Pat Gelsinger to invest nearly $10 million in company stock. According to SEC filings, Gelsinger purchased 150,000 shares at $64.71 to $64.74 per share on November 2, totaling $9.7 million, executed through a family trust.

Following Jensen Huang’s departure, Colette Kress, who has overseen NVIDIA’s finances for 13 years, temporarily assumes the company’s heavy responsibilities. She has witnessed NVIDIA’s transformation from a gaming chipmaker to an AI powerhouse and has been involved in controversial client‑financing strategies. Now, as the long‑time CFO beside Huang, Kress must step forward, stabilize operations, and maintain market confidence while the company searches for a permanent successor.

items.title: 黃仁勳請辭恐波及美開源AI  SemiAnalysis揭輝達供應鏈與新創兩大考驗
items.title_en: NVIDIA Co-Founder Jensen Huang Resigns, Potential Impact on U.S. Open-Source AI Ecosystem, SemiAnalysis Highlights Supply Chain and Startup Challenges
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 共同創辦人黃仁勳請辭後，市場焦點迅速轉向執行長接班，但半導體研究機構 SemiAnalysis 認為，另一個可能受到衝擊的是美國開源人工智慧 (AI) 生態。若華府加強限制中國業者取得先進 GPU 算力，輝達與中國 AI 實驗室的合作也可能縮減。屆時，仰賴中國開放模型與推論軟體的美國新創，將更難取得原本可直接採用的技術成果。
SemiAnalysis 分析師 Dylan Patel 等人在 11 月 12 日發布的報告中寫道：「美國的開源生態系與許多新創公司仰賴中國 AI 模型。隨著黃仁勳離任、對中鷹派占上風，這套生態將受到重大衝擊。」
這種依賴從模型延伸到讓模型跑得更快的底層軟體。
SemiAnalysis 指出，中國部分尖端 AI 實驗室使用輝達 Blackwell GPU，輝達的開發者技術團隊也與這些實驗室合作，協助改善模型在 GPU 上的執行效率。
中國團隊公開的 DeepGEMM、DeepEP 等工具，分別用於加速矩陣運算與改善多張 GPU 之間的資料傳輸，相關成果已被 SGLang、vLLM 等廣泛使用的推論框架採用。
研究團隊認為，若輝達對開放模型的資金與工程支援減弱，同時美國收緊對中算力管制，中國實驗室可能把更多為 Blackwell 開發的最佳化工具留在內部。
對美國新創而言，能直接使用的開源工具變少，就可能得自行投入更多工程人力，才能把模型跑到同等效率。
SemiAnalysis 認為，這將讓已有自研模型與軟體能力的封閉式 AI 實驗室取得相對優勢。
開源 AI 也是輝達擴大 GPU 客戶群的一環。
SemiAnalysis 指出，大型雲端業者與前沿 AI 實驗室正投入自研晶片，而開放模型讓企業、政府及新興雲端業者也能自行部署 AI，為輝達創造更多 GPU 需求。
接班人若降低對開放模型的投入，輝達就更難透過這些客戶分散對少數大型買家的依賴。
黃仁勳離任後，另一項變數是華府會不會把對中晶片管制延伸至遠端算力。
SemiAnalysis 點名《遠端存取安全法案》(RASA)，指出政策焦點已從先進晶片能否出口到中國，擴大至中國企業能否透過海外資料中心使用這些晶片。
研究團隊主張，可透過受信任的雲端業者提供有限、可監管的算力，並對使用量設限。
分析師認為，若全面切斷中國實驗室取得輝達算力的管道，反而可能加速當地業者改用自研或中國製加速器，削弱輝達在當地 AI 軟體生態的影響力。
對台灣供應鏈而言，接班考驗則落在產能談判。
SemiAnalysis 指出，黃仁勳長期親自與台灣晶片供應商及南韓記憶體廠談判，提前鎖定邏輯晶圓、高頻寬記憶體 (HBM) 等關鍵產能。
以 SK 海力士 2027 年 HBM4 為例，該機構估計，輝達採購價格約為每 Gb 3 至 3.3 美元，其他一線客戶約為 3.7 至 4.1 美元。
分析師認為，若接班人難以維持同等的供應優先權，超微 (AMD-US)、博通 (AVGO-US) 及自研晶片的雲端業者，可能更容易取得新增產能。
輝達已任命財務長克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 代理執行長，並將從公司內外尋找正式接班人。
SemiAnalysis 指出，黃仁勳有約 60 名直屬主管，產品方向、供應商談判和客戶配貨等重大決策長期由他統籌。
這套扁平架構讓輝達在方向確立後能快速動員，也使接班人必須同時協調多條產品線與供應鏈。
研究團隊認為，接班後最難延續的，可能是輝達在短期回報有限時，仍願意持續投入的能力。
CUDA 就是先例，這項技術早年多年虧損、屢遭華爾街質疑，後來成為輝達 GPU 在 AI 市場的重要競爭優勢。
paras_en: After NVIDIA co‑founder Jensen Huang resigned, market focus quickly shifted to the CEO succession, but semiconductor research firm SemiAnalysis believes another area that could be affected is the U.S. open‑source AI ecosystem. If Washington tightens restrictions on Chinese firms accessing advanced GPU compute, NVIDIA’s collaboration with Chinese AI labs may also shrink, making it harder for U.S. startups that rely on Chinese open models and inference software to obtain the technology that was previously readily available.

SemiAnalysis analysts Dylan Patel and others wrote in a report released on November 12: “The U.S. open‑source ecosystem and many startups rely on Chinese AI models. With Huang’s departure and a hawkish stance prevailing, this ecosystem will suffer a major blow.”
This dependence extends from the models themselves to the underlying software that makes the models run faster.

SemiAnalysis pointed out that some of China’s cutting‑edge AI labs use NVIDIA’s Blackwell GPUs, and NVIDIA’s developer technical team collaborates with these labs to improve model execution efficiency on GPUs.

The Chinese teams have publicly released tools such as DeepGEMM and DeepEP, which accelerate matrix operations and improve data transfer between multiple GPUs; these results have been adopted by inference frameworks widely used by SGLang, vLLM, and others.

The research team believes that if NVIDIA weakens funding and engineering support for open models, and the U.S. tightens compute restrictions on China, Chinese labs may keep more of the optimization tools developed for Blackwell in-house.
For U.S. startups, fewer directly usable open‑source tools could mean more engineering effort is required to achieve comparable efficiency.
SemiAnalysis thinks this will give closed‑source AI labs with their own models and software a relative advantage.
Open‑source AI is also part of NVIDIA’s strategy to broaden its GPU customer base.

SemiAnalysis noted that large cloud providers and cutting‑edge AI labs are investing in in‑house chips, while open models allow enterprises, governments, and emerging cloud providers to deploy AI themselves, creating more GPU demand for NVIDIA.
If the successor reduces investment in open models, NVIDIA will find it harder to diversify its customer base away from a few large buyers through these clients.
After Huang’s resignation, another variable is whether Washington will extend chip controls to remote compute.

SemiAnalysis cited the Remote Access Security Act (RASA), noting that policy focus has shifted from whether advanced chips can be exported to China to whether Chinese firms can use those chips via overseas data centers.
The research team argues that trusted cloud providers could offer limited, regulated compute and impose usage limits.

Analysts believe that a complete cut‑off of Chinese labs’ access to NVIDIA compute could actually accelerate local firms switching to in‑house or China‑made accelerators, weakening NVIDIA’s influence in the local AI software ecosystem.
For Taiwan’s supply chain, the succession test falls on capacity negotiations.

SemiAnalysis pointed out that Huang has long personally negotiated with Taiwanese chip suppliers and Korean memory manufacturers, locking in key capacities such as logic wafers and high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) ahead of time.
Taking SK Hynix’s 2027 HBM4 as an example, the firm estimates NVIDIA’s purchase price is about $3 to $3.3 per GB, while other first‑tier customers pay about $3.7 to $4.1 per GB.
Analysts think that if the successor cannot maintain the same supply priority, AMD, Broadcom, and cloud providers with in‑house chips may more easily secure additional capacity.
NVIDIA has appointed CFO Colette Kress as acting CEO and will search for a permanent successor both inside and outside the company.
SemiAnalysis noted that Huang has about 60 direct reports, and major decisions on product direction, supplier negotiations, and customer allocations have long been coordinated by him.
This flat structure allows NVIDIA to mobilize quickly after setting a direction, but it also means the successor must coordinate multiple product lines and the supply chain simultaneously.
The research team believes the hardest thing to continue after succession may be NVIDIA’s willingness to keep investing when short‑term returns are limited.
CUDA is a precedent; the technology ran at a loss for many years and faced Wall Street criticism, yet it later became a key competitive advantage for NVIDIA GPUs in the AI market.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元升至19個月新高 市場焦點轉向利率預期
items.title_en: <New York Forex Market> Dollar Rises to 19-Month High, Market Focus Shifts to Rate Expectations
paras: 美元週四(12日)走強，升至約19個月以來最高水準。由於投資人重新評估聯準會（Fed）未來的利率政策走向，市場對聯準會採取更強硬升息立場的預期升高，進而推升美國公債殖利率。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.3%，報103.16，仍維持在2025年4月以來的最高水準。
本週多位聯準會官員警告，通膨仍維持在頑強的高檔水準。其中一些官員表示，如果物價壓力未能緩解，他們不排除升息50個基點的可能性。
週二公布的美國通膨數據強於預期，進一步強化了這項看法，也促使交易員提高對聯準會進一步緊縮貨幣政策的預期。
歐元兌美元下跌0.28%，至1歐元兌1.10585美元，創下2025年4月以來最低。
美元兌瑞士法郎上漲0.14%，至0.834瑞郎，達到一個月以來新高。
Moneycorp交易與結構性商品部門主管 Eugene Epstein 表示，「美元走強幾乎完全是受到市場對聯準會政策預期的影響。如果觀察聯邦基金利率期貨，過去幾天它與美元走勢之間的相關性相當高。而聯邦基金利率期貨之所以走高，主要有兩個原因：（一）消費者物價指數（CPI）高於預期；（二）多位聯準會官員發表了相當多偏鷹的言論。」
根據芝商所（CME） FedWatch 工具，投資人目前預估聯準會在12月升息的機率已達91%。通常會隨聯準會利率預期同步變動的美國2年期公債殖利率，最新上升10.79個基點，來到4.835%。美國10年期公債殖利率則上升7.94個基點，來到5.068%。
包括高盛在內的一些券商，目前甚至預期聯準會除了12月升息之外，明年初還可能再升息一次。
日元走勢
日本最高貨幣外交官三村淳（Atsushi Mimura）週四警告市場參與者，對於今年夏季日本政府曾進場干預匯市一事，「現在還不是可以忘記的時候」。
由於日元再次逼近1美元兌160日元重要關卡，市場對日本政府可能再次干預匯市的警戒也隨之升高。
根據《路透社》一項分析師調查，許多分析師預期，日本央行（BoJ）最快可能在下個月升息。週四公布數據也進一步強化了這項看法。數據顯示，日本10月份批發物價年增率重新加速至7.1%，高於9月份的6.8%。
日元兌美元下跌0.13%，至1美元兌159.975日元，創下9月以來最低水準。
澳幣兌美元下跌0.58%，至0.6808美元，創下今年1月以來最低。
紐幣兌美元則下跌0.25%，來到0.5548美元。

paras_en: The dollar strengthened on Thursday (the 12th), climbing to its highest level in about 19 months. Investors reassessed the Fed’s future rate policy trajectory, raising expectations that the Fed will adopt a more aggressive rate‑hike stance, which in turn pushed U.S. Treasury yields higher.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.3% to 103.16, still holding its peak since April 2025.
Several Fed officials this week warned that inflation remains stubbornly high. Some officials said that if price pressures do not ease, they would not rule out a 50‑basis‑point rate hike.
U.S. inflation data released on Tuesday came in stronger than expected, reinforcing that view and prompting traders to raise expectations for further tightening by the Fed.
The euro fell 0.28% against the dollar to $1.10585 per euro, a low not seen since April 2025.
The dollar rose 0.14% against the Swiss franc to 0.834 franc, a one‑month high.

Eugene Epstein, head of Moneycorp’s trading and structured products division, said, “The dollar’s strength is almost entirely driven by market expectations of Fed policy. Looking at fed‑fund futures, the correlation with the dollar’s move has been very high over the past few days. Fed‑fund futures are rising for two main reasons: (1) CPI came in above expectations; (2) a number of Fed officials have made decidedly hawkish comments.”

According to CME’s FedWatch tool, investors now see a 91% probability that the Fed will raise rates in December. The U.S. 2‑year Treasury yield, which usually moves in step with Fed‑rate expectations, rose 10.79 basis points to 4.835%. The 10‑year yield climbed 7.94 basis points to 5.068%.
Some brokerages, including Goldman Sachs, now even expect that, besides a December hike, the Fed could deliver another rate increase early next year.
Yen movement

Japan’s top currency diplomat Atsushi Mimura warned market participants on Thursday that, regarding the government’s intervention in the foreign‑exchange market during this summer, “the time to forget it has not yet arrived.”
As the yen again approached the critical 160‑per‑dollar threshold, market vigilance over a possible renewed intervention by the Japanese government rose.

A Reuters analyst poll shows many analysts expect the Bank of Japan could raise rates as early as next month. Thursday’s data further reinforced that view, with October wholesale price inflation accelerating to 7.1% year‑on‑year, up from 6.8% in September.
The yen slipped 0.13% to 159.975 per dollar, its lowest level since September.
The Australian dollar fell 0.58% to $0.6808, its lowest since January this year.
The New Zealand dollar dropped 0.25% to $0.5548.

items.title: 日元逼近160關卡！日本匯率主管再警告市場勿忘夏季干預 暗示可能單獨出手
items.title_en: Yen Nearing the 160 Barrier! Japan's Exchange Rate Chief Warns Market Not to Forget Summer Intervention, Hints at Possible Solo Action
paras: 日元兌美元匯率再度逼近160這個日本當局曾出手干預的重要關卡之際，日本最高外匯事務官員三村淳(Atsushi Mimura)周四(12日)警告市場參與者，「現在還不是忘記今年夏季干預行動的時候」，顯示日本當局已準備好再次出手干預，以支撐日元。
日本財務省主管匯率事務的最高官員三村淳說：「我強烈感覺到，過去幾天的匯率波動速度太快了。」他並表示：「現在還不是忘記今年夏天發生什麼事的時候。」不過，他沒有針對特定匯率水準發表評論。
這是三村淳自9月底以來首度針對外匯市場發表談話，而他所指的是日本7月底至8月初買進日元的干預行動，包括與美國聯手進場的操作。
三村淳發出警告之際，日元兌美元匯率周四盤中一度升至159.94，創逾兩個月來新高。日元先前貶破160關卡之後，日本當局7月曾連續三天進場支撐日元，其中一部分還是與美國協調進行的。夏季那波為期三天的干預行動協助日元兌美元匯率從貶破163，回升至最高155.23。
在聯手干預行動後，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)與日本財務大臣片山皋月曾警告，當局已準備好再次採取行動，以因應匯市波動。

日元走弱推升進口成本 日本通膨壓力升高

日元疲軟一直是日本決策官員面臨的棘手問題，這導致進口成本大幅攀升。周四公布的數據顯示，以日元計價的進口物價指數10月年增24.8%。
美國通膨數據偏熱，加上聯準會(Fed)官員發表鷹派談話，讓市場愈來愈預期美國將升息，帶動美元走強。而在市場預期美日利差將進一步擴大的情況下，日元再度蒙受壓力。
日本方面，市場已大致消化日本銀行(BOJ，央行)將在12月18日至19日會議升息的預期。但後續升息時程仍不明朗，因為市場預期日本政策利率將逐步接近中性利率水準。
瑞穗證券分析師說：「美國經濟展現韌性，加上人工智慧(AI)投資強勁帶動通膨持續處於高檔，美元兌日元匯率可能繼續走高。」
報告指出：「如果美元突破160關卡，且日元進一步走弱推升通膨，增加首相高市早苗政府支持度下滑的風險，東京當局可能採取單方面干預行動。」
paras_en: The yen‑dollar exchange rate is once again approaching the 160 level, a key threshold where Japanese authorities have previously intervened, and Japan's top foreign‑exchange official Atsushi Mimura warned market participants on Thursday (the 12th) that "now is not the time to forget this summer's intervention action," indicating that the authorities are ready to step in again to support the yen.

Mimura, the senior official in charge of exchange‑rate matters at the Ministry of Finance, said, "I strongly feel that the speed of exchange‑rate fluctuations over the past few days has been too rapid," adding, "Now is not the time to forget what happened this summer." He did not comment on any specific exchange‑rate level.

This is Mimura's first public comment on the FX market since the end of September, referring to Japan's July‑late‑August early‑August yen‑buying intervention, which was carried out in coordination with the United States.

When Mimura issued his warning, the yen‑dollar rate rose intraday on Thursday to 159.94, a two‑month high. After the yen slipped past the 160 barrier, Japanese authorities intervened for three consecutive days in July, part of which was coordinated with the U.S. That three‑day summer intervention helped lift the yen from a dip below 163 back up to a peak of 155.23.

Following the joint intervention, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Japanese Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki warned that the authorities were prepared to act again in response to market volatility.
A weaker yen is pushing up import costs, raising inflation pressure in Japan. Data released on Thursday showed that the import price index, measured in yen, rose 24.8% year‑on‑year in October.

U.S. inflation data remains hot and hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials have heightened expectations of further U.S. rate hikes, strengthening the dollar. With markets expecting the Japan‑U.S. interest‑rate gap to widen, the yen faces renewed pressure.

In Japan, markets have largely priced in expectations that the Bank of Japan will raise rates at its meeting on December 18‑19, but the timing of any further hikes remains unclear as markets anticipate the policy rate moving gradually toward a neutral level.
Mizuho Securities analysts said, "The U.S. economy is showing resilience, and strong AI‑driven investment is keeping inflation at elevated levels, so the dollar‑yen pair may continue to rise."

The report noted, "If the dollar breaks the 160 barrier and the yen weakens further, pushing up inflation and increasing the risk of declining support for Prime Minister Kishida's government, Tokyo authorities may resort to unilateral intervention."

items.title: 美元飆上19個月高點！全球市場迎新風暴 聯準會12月升息幾無懸念
items.title_en: Dollar Soars to 19-Month High! Global Markets Face New Storm as Fed December Rate Hike Becomes All but Certain
paras: 美國通膨持續升溫，加上聯準會（Fed）官員接連釋出鷹派訊號，市場升息預期急速升溫，ICE 美元指數周三（11 日）一度升至 102.96，創下 19 個月新高。
隨著交易員開始押注聯準會 12 月可能一口氣升息 2 碼，短期美債殖利率飆升，全球主要貨幣普遍承壓，美元漲勢成為市場關注焦點。
隨著交易員開始將聯準會 12 月升息 2 碼納入定價，美債殖利率走揚、全球主要貨幣承壓，美元成為金融市場關注焦點。
行情數據顯示，衡量美元兌一籃子主要貨幣表現的 ICE 美元指數(DXY) ，周三盤中最高觸及 102.96，創下 2025 年 4 月以來最高水準。
另一項廣受市場關注的彭博美元指數，也創下今年 6 月以來最大兩日漲幅，盤中觸及 2025 年 5 月以來最高水準。美元當天兌幾乎所有主要貨幣均走強，顯示買盤持續湧入。
美元本波漲勢在周二明顯加速，主要受到美國通膨數據與聯準會官員鷹派言論雙重推動。
最新數據顯示，美國 10 月消費者物價漲幅連續第三個月高於市場預期，促使交易員重新評估聯準會未來升息幅度，甚至開始將 12 月一次升息 50 個基點（2 碼）的可能性納入定價。
隨著短期美債殖利率飆升，美國與其他主要經濟體之間的利差擴大，進一步吸引追求較高報酬的資金流向美元資產。
12月升息1碼機率達88% 華爾街上修預測
加拿大帝國商業銀行（CIBC）策略師 Jeremy Stretch 表示，美元近期走強，核心原因在於市場持續重新調整對聯準會貨幣政策路徑的預期。
他指出，無論是聯準會一次升息 50 個基點，或加快目前每季升息一次的緊縮步伐，如今都已成為市場實際討論的政策選項。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）數據，周三貨幣市場預估，聯準會 12 月升息 25 個基點的機率達 88%，升息 50 個基點的機率則為 12%。
在周二通膨數據公布後，華爾街主要券商也陸續調整利率預測。
高盛目前預估，聯準會將分別在今年 12 月及明年 3 月升息；德意志銀行則預期，聯準會將在今年 12 月、明年 1 月及 3 月連續升息，顯示市場對貨幣政策進一步緊縮的預期正在升高。
美元還能漲多高？市場緊盯PPI數據
不過，在 12 月升息逐漸成為市場基本預期後，美元能否進一步突破高點，仍取決於後續經濟數據與聯準會政策訊號。
DHF Capital 資產經理 Bas Kooijman 表示，若美元要延續漲勢，市場可能需要進一步提高對聯準會升息 50 個基點的押注。
他指出，若周五公布的美國生產者物價指數（PPI）再度高於預期，或聯準會官員持續釋出鷹派訊號，可能進一步推升美債殖利率，帶動美元突破近期高點。
反之，若經濟數據轉弱，或投資人對大幅升息的預期降溫，美元可能回吐部分漲幅。
值得注意的是，美國公債市場周三因退伍軍人節假期休市。
歐元跌破1.11 法國債務問題再添壓力
美元強勢走高，也持續對其他主要貨幣形成壓力。
今年以來，除了澳元與挪威克朗之外，多數 G10 已開發市場貨幣兌美元均呈現貶值，反映美國與其他經濟體之間不斷擴大的利差。
部分分析師也認為，今年美元的強勢表現，部分來自美國與以色列對伊朗戰爭期間湧入的避險資金。
其中，歐元承受的壓力尤其明顯。
歐元兌美元隔夜下跌 0.65%，跌破 1.11 美元關卡，延續前一交易日跌勢，並觸及 2025 年 5 月以來最低水準。
除了美元走強，法國債務問題持續拖累歐元，加上近期油價回落，市場對歐洲央行升息的預期也有所降溫。
荷蘭合作銀行（Rabobank）外匯策略師 Jane Foley 指出，歐洲央行上次新聞發布會透露，管理委員會對經濟成長前景的擔憂日益加深。
她表示，另一項可能在未來數月壓抑歐元的因素，是明年法國總統大選帶來的政治不確定性。若極右派候選人當選總統，可能對歐盟未來合作方向產生影響。
荷蘭合作銀行預估，歐元兌美元將在未來三個月內進一步跌至 1.10。
隨著聯準會升息預期持續升溫，市場接下來將密切關注美國通膨數據與官員談話，判斷美元是否仍有進一步走強的空間。
paras_en: U.S. inflation continues to heat up, and Fed officials have been issuing hawkish signals, causing rate‑hike expectations to surge. The ICE Dollar Index rose to 102.96 on Wednesday (the 11th), hitting a 19‑month peak.

As traders began betting that the Fed could raise rates by two full points in December, short‑term U.S. Treasury yields spiked, major currencies worldwide came under pressure, and the dollar’s rally became the market’s focal point.
With traders pricing in a two‑point Fed hike in December, Treasury yields climbed, major currencies were pressured, and the dollar took center stage in financial markets.
Market data show that the ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the dollar against a basket of major currencies, reached a intraday high of 102.96 on Wednesday, the highest level since April 2025.

Another widely‑watched gauge, the Bloomberg Dollar Index, also posted its biggest two‑day gain since June this year, touching its highest level since May 2025. The dollar strengthened against almost all major currencies, indicating continued buying pressure.
The dollar’s current rally accelerated noticeably on Tuesday, driven by a combination of U.S. inflation data and hawkish comments from Fed officials.

The latest data show that U.S. consumer price inflation for October was higher than market expectations for the third consecutive month, prompting traders to reassess the Fed’s future rate‑hike magnitude and even start pricing in a possible 50‑basis‑point (two‑point) hike in December.
As short‑term Treasury yields surged, the yield gap between the United States and other major economies widened, further attracting funds seeking higher returns into dollar‑denominated assets.
Probability of a one‑point December hike reaches 88% as Wall Street revises forecasts.
CIBC strategist Jeremy Stretch said the dollar’s recent strength is mainly due to the market’s ongoing recalibration of expectations for the Fed’s monetary‑policy path.
He noted that whether the Fed raises rates by 50 basis points in a single move or accelerates its current quarterly‑rate‑hike cadence, both options are now being seriously discussed in the market.

According to London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) data, Wednesday’s currency‑market estimates put the probability of a 25‑basis‑point Fed hike in December at 88%, while a 50‑basis‑point hike was seen at 12%.
After Tuesday’s inflation data release, major Wall Street brokerages began adjusting their rate forecasts.

Goldman Sachs now expects the Fed to raise rates in both December this year and March next year; Deutsche Bank forecasts hikes in December, January and March, indicating rising market expectations for further monetary tightening.
How high can the dollar go? Markets keep a close eye on PPI data.
However, once a December hike becomes the market’s baseline expectation, whether the dollar can push beyond its recent peak will depend on upcoming economic data and Fed policy signals.
DHF Capital asset manager Bas Kooijman said that for the dollar to keep climbing, the market may need to increase its bets on a 50‑basis‑point Fed hike.

He added that if Friday’s U.S. Producer Price Index (PPI) comes in above expectations, or if Fed officials continue to issue hawkish remarks, Treasury yields could rise further, propelling the dollar past its recent high.
Conversely, weaker economic data or a cooling of expectations for large rate hikes could see the dollar give back some of its gains.
It is worth noting that the U.S. Treasury market was closed on Wednesday for the Veterans Day holiday.
Euro slips below 1.11 as French debt woes add pressure.
The strong dollar continues to weigh on other major currencies.

Since the start of the year, most G10 developed‑market currencies have depreciated against the dollar, except for the Australian dollar and the Norwegian krone, reflecting the widening yield differentials between the U.S. and other economies.
Some analysts also attribute part of the dollar’s strength this year to safe‑haven flows that surged during the U.S.–Israel conflict with Iran.
The euro, in particular, feels the pressure.
The euro fell 0.65% against the dollar overnight, breaking below the 1.11‑dollar mark and extending the decline from the previous trading day, reaching its lowest level since May 2025.
In addition to the strong dollar, France’s debt problems continue to drag the euro down, and a recent pullback in oil prices has cooled expectations for European Central Bank rate hikes.
Rabobank foreign‑exchange strategist Jane Foley noted that the ECB’s last press conference revealed growing concerns among the Governing Council about the economic‑growth outlook.

She added that another factor that could suppress the euro in the coming months is the political uncertainty surrounding next year’s French presidential election; a victory by a far‑right candidate could affect the EU’s future cooperation direction.
Rabobank projects that the euro will fall further to around 1.10 against the dollar within the next three months.
As expectations for Fed rate hikes continue to rise, markets will closely monitor U.S. inflation data and Fed officials’ remarks to gauge whether the dollar still has room to strengthen further.

Elias Haddad, Global Market Strategy Head at Brown Brothers Harriman, said that higher rate‑hike expectations help support the dollar.

Fed officials, including Governor Christopher Waller and Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan, expressed concern over persistently high inflation, with Waller even not ruling out a substantial 50‑basis‑point hike, further lifting market rate‑hike bets.

Goldman Sachs and Deutsche Bank revised forecasts, expecting most major currencies to depreciate this year.

items.title: 歐洲央行：若年底前未達協議 數位歐元推出時程恐延至2029年後
items.title_en: European Central Bank: If No Agreement by Year‑End, Digital Euro Launch Could Slip Past 2029
paras: 歐洲央行(ECB)發出警訊，指出歐盟若無法在今(2026)年底前就「單一貨幣法案包」達成協議，原定於 2029 年首次發行的數位歐元(Digital Euro)計畫恐面臨延後。
隨著 2026 年僅剩約七周時間，歐洲央行正全力敦促歐盟立法機構加快腳步，以確保整體籌備工作具備明確的法律確定性。
歐洲央行執行董事奇波洛內(Piero Cipollone)於 11 月 10 日出席歐洲議會經濟及貨幣事務委員會時明確指出，立法延宕將直接推遲數位歐元的上路時程。
奇波洛內特別提到了歐盟在基礎設施上的風險，表示目前歐元區高達三分之二的信用卡支付受控制於外國業者，並指出：「近年歐洲已深刻體會到在能源與國防上不能單純依賴第三方，支付領域也是如此。」他警告，延遲發行將加深歐洲對外國支付服務商的依賴，並打擊在地企業的創新發展空間。
同時，歐洲央行總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)也將數位歐元視為關鍵應對方案，並警告指出，錨定美元的私營穩定幣若大規模普及，將可能削弱央行對貨幣政策的掌控能力。
面對大眾對實體貨幣存廢的疑慮，歐洲議會官員Fernando Navarrete Rojas強調，數位歐元的定位十分清晰，「將作為現金的補充手段，絕不會取代現金。」
目前歐洲議會正與歐盟理事會及歐盟執委會展開三方協商。法案談判的核心爭議主要集中於三大面向：個人隱私保護、交易手續費架構以及個人持有限額。
若歐盟能於今年完成立法，歐洲央行預計於 2027 年下半年啟動為期 12 個月的技術試辦計畫，屆時將有 36 家市場營運商、支付服務業者及實體商家參與日常支付情境的實測。
paras_en: The European Central Bank (ECB) warned that if the EU fails to reach an agreement on the “single currency law package” by the end of this year (2026), the Digital Euro project originally slated for a first issuance in 2029 could be delayed.
With only about seven weeks left in 2026, the ECB is urging EU legislators to accelerate the process to ensure the overall preparation work has clear legal certainty.

ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone said on 10 November, when speaking to the European Parliament’s Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs, that legislative delays would directly push back the timetable for the Digital Euro’s rollout.

Cipollone highlighted infrastructure risks, noting that roughly two‑thirds of euro‑area card payments are currently controlled by foreign operators, and warned that “Europe has learned in recent years that it cannot rely solely on third parties for energy and defence, and the payments sector is no different.” He cautioned that a postponed launch would deepen Europe’s reliance on foreign payment service providers and curb innovation by local firms.

ECB President Christine Lagarde also framed the Digital Euro as a key response tool, warning that a privately‑issued, dollar‑pegged stablecoin gaining widespread use could erode central banks’ control over monetary policy.

Addressing public concerns about the future of physical cash, European Parliament official Fernando Navarrete Rojas stressed that the Digital Euro’s role is clear: “It will be a complementary means to cash, never a replacement.”

The European Parliament is currently in trilateral talks with the EU Council and the European Commission. The core disputes in the legislative negotiations centre on three issues: personal data protection, transaction fee structures and individual holding limits.

If the EU completes the legislation this year, the ECB expects to launch a 12‑month technical pilot in the second half of 2027, involving 36 market operators, payment service providers and physical merchants testing everyday payment scenarios.

items.title: 美元升息預期重燃 日元跌至一個半月新低 直逼159關卡
items.title_en: Dollar Rate‑Hike Expectations Resurge, Yen Falls to One‑and‑a‑Half‑Month Low Near 159 Barrier
paras: 日元周三(11日)亞市走勢持續疲軟，兌美元匯率回落至158.97附近，盤中跌幅約0.14%，並創下9月下旬以來約一個半月的新低紀錄。
市場分析指出，美國高於預期的CPI數據激發市場對美國聯準會升息的預期，美債殖利率大幅攀升帶動美日利差擴大，吸引利差交易資金及日本進口商的實需買盤進場，進一步推低日元。
隨著通膨疑慮再起，聯準會多位官員發表鷹派言論，亦為美元提供強勁支撐。
聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)在通膨數據公布前即表示，若10月核心通膨達到0.3%，央行應考慮在下個月評估升息2碼(50個基點)。數據公布後，達拉斯聯邦準備銀行總裁洛根(Lorie Logan)暗示更強勁的通膨可能需要加快升息步伐；芝加哥聯邦準備銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)更直言，這份物價報告「是另一份令人不安、甚至是接近令人困擾的報告」。
面對市場迅速計入聯準會加速升息的可能性，第一生命經濟研究所經濟學家Seiji Katsurahata提出不同觀點。Katsurahata認為，市場目前對聯準會12月升息2碼的猜測顯得過度反應；隨著市場定價最終穩定在升息1碼(25個基點)，短期美債殖利率應會趨於正常化，美元匯率的上行空間預期將受限。
同時，分析師認為日本銀行(BOJ)可能必須跟進升息，以防止日元進一步走貶。日本銀行最新會議意見摘要顯示，決策官員對通膨上行風險仍保持高度警惕，並支持採取進一步升息措施。受美國國債殖利率飆升影響，日本10年期基準國債殖利率當日亦攀升至2.785%。
日元持續貶值雖提升日本出口商的盈利能力，但進口能源與原料成本上漲已顯著加重企業負擔，並引發國內消費者物價壓力。
paras_en: The yen continued its weak performance in Asian markets on Wednesday (the 11th), slipping back to around 158.97 per dollar, down about 0.14% intraday, marking a new low of about one and a half months since late September.

Market analysis points out that U.S. CPI data that came in above expectations sparked expectations of Fed rate hikes, causing U.S. Treasury yields to surge and widening the U.S.-Japan interest rate differential, attracting carry‑trade funds and genuine buying from Japanese importers, further pushing the yen lower.
With inflation concerns resurfacing, several Fed officials have made hawkish remarks, also providing strong support for the dollar.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller said before the inflation data release that if core inflation hits 0.3% in October, the central bank should consider evaluating a 2‑point (50‑basis‑point) rate hike next month. After the data were released, Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan hinted that stronger inflation might require a faster pace of hikes; Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee was even more blunt, calling the price report “another unsettling, even bordering on troubling, report.”

Facing the market’s rapid pricing in of a faster Fed tightening, Seiji Katsurahata, an economist at the First Life Economic Research Institute, offered a different view. Katsurahata believes the market’s speculation that the Fed will raise rates by 2 points in December is an overreaction; as the market pricing settles at a 1‑point (25‑basis‑point) hike, short‑term Treasury yields should normalize and the upside potential for the dollar is expected to be limited.

At the same time, analysts think the Bank of Japan may have to follow suit with rate hikes to prevent further yen depreciation. The latest BOJ meeting minutes show that policymakers remain highly vigilant about inflation upside risks and support taking additional tightening measures. Affected by the surge in U.S. Treasury yields, Japan’s 10‑year benchmark government bond yield also rose to 2.785% that day.

While the yen’s continued depreciation boosts the profitability of Japanese exporters, higher import costs for energy and raw materials have significantly increased corporate burdens and sparked domestic consumer price pressures.

items.title: 香港上市債券市場重大突破 人民幣歷史性超越美元
items.title_en: Hong Kong Listed Bond Market Achieves Major Breakthrough as RMB Historically Overtakes USD
paras: 2026年前三季度，香港上市債券市場迎來歷史性轉折。信用評級機構大公國際香港最新統計顯示，以離岸人民幣計價的債券(簡稱「點心債」)占總發行額比重達37%，歷史性超越美元債券的33%，使離岸人民幣正式躍升為香港上市債券市場最大的發行幣種。
統計指出，截至2026年9月末，香港上市點心債發行規模已達2,868億元人民幣，一舉超越2025年全年總額，港交所上市發行數量達117檔，明顯多於美元債的77檔。
分析指出，在美國聯準會維持高利率背景下，美元債融資成本高企，使點心債的成本優勢更加凸顯。此外，發行主體呈現多元化與國際化趨勢，除了中資科技企業騰訊、京東與國家電網等機構外，美國安達保險、匈牙利國家儲蓄商業銀行及哈薩克國家石油天然氣公司等外資機構也積極赴港發行，顯示點心債正加速演變為全球投資者認可的離岸資產配置標竿。
針對市場新局，香港特區政府財經事務及庫務局副局長陳浩濂在交流會中明確指出，香港正「從一個金融的城市，走向金融賦能的城市」。
陳浩濂強調，金融是香港最大優勢，全球金融中心排名世界第三、亞洲第一，未來特區政府將以「金融+」為核心抓手，深化金融與科技、綠色及民生實體領域的融合，充分發揮香港作為「超級聯繫人」與「超級增值人」的角色。
發表研究報告的大公國際香港則提醒，點心債市場快速擴容的同時，仍面臨期限結構與流動性需求錯配、歐美長線資金參與深度不足，以及債匯聯動機制與風險對沖工具尚待完善等結構性挑戰。該機構強調，建構高質量的跨境信用生態，將是推動離岸人民幣債市從「規模擴張」走向「質效提升」的關鍵支撐。
paras_en: In the first three quarters of 2026, Hong Kong's listed bond market experienced a historic turning point. The latest statistics from rating agency Dagong International Hong Kong show that offshore RMB‑denominated bonds (commonly called “dim sum bonds”) accounted for 37% of total issuance, a historic overtaking of USD bonds at 33%, making offshore RMB the largest currency for issuance in Hong Kong’s listed bond market.

The data indicate that by the end of September 2026, the issuance volume of Hong Kong‑listed dim sum bonds had reached RMB 286.8 billion, surpassing the entire 2025 annual total. A total of 117 dim sum bond issues were listed on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong, clearly outnumbering the 77 USD‑denominated issues.

Analysts point out that, with the U.S. Federal Reserve maintaining high interest rates, the financing cost of USD bonds remains elevated, highlighting the cost advantage of dim sum bonds. Moreover, issuers are becoming more diversified and international: besides Chinese tech giants such as Tencent and JD.com and state‑owned entities like State Grid, foreign institutions such as U.S. insurer AIG, Hungary’s National Savings Commercial Bank and Kazakhstan’s National Oil and Gas Company are actively issuing in Hong Kong, indicating that dim sum bonds are rapidly evolving into a globally recognised offshore asset‑allocation benchmark.

Regarding the new market dynamics, Hong Kong SAR Government Deputy Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, Chan Ho‑lin, said at a briefing that Hong Kong is moving “from a financial city to a financially‑empowered city.”

Chan Ho‑lin stressed that finance is Hong Kong’s greatest advantage, ranking third worldwide and first in Asia as a global financial centre. The SAR government will centre its strategy on “Finance+,” deepening the integration of finance with technology, green initiatives and real‑economy sectors, fully leveraging Hong Kong’s role as a “super connector” and “super value‑adder.”

Dagong International Hong Kong, which released the research report, warned that while the dim sum bond market is expanding rapidly, it still faces structural challenges such as mismatches between maturity structure and liquidity demand, insufficient participation from long‑term European and American capital, and underdeveloped bond‑FX linkage mechanisms and hedging tools. The agency stressed that building a high‑quality cross‑border credit ecosystem will be key to moving the offshore RMB bond market from “scale expansion” to “quality and efficiency improvement.”
